name: office-open-xml-viewer
description: High-fidelity local viewer for Office files (.docx / .xlsx / .pptx), powered by Rust/WASM and Canvas. Optional MCP integration can share requested context with an AI agent.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Viewing files works in untrusted workspaces. Google Fonts and the MCP server are disabled until you trust the workspace because they perform network or local-process operations.

colors.description: Background of ordinary search matches in Office previews.
Background of the active search match in Office previews.

keybindings.when: activeCustomEditorId == ooxmlViewer.docxEditor || activeCustomEditorId == ooxmlViewer.xlsxEditor || activeCustomEditorId == ooxmlViewer.pptxEditor

ooxmlViewer.useGoogleFonts.markdownDescription:
Load metric-compatible substitute fonts (Carlito for Calibri, Caladea for Cambria, Noto for Arabic, etc.) from `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com` so text layout matches Word / PowerPoint / Excel on machines without those fonts installed.

**The extension makes no network requests when this is disabled (the default).** Enabling it is the only thing that lets the preview reach the font CDN. The setting is also ignored in untrusted workspaces. Changes apply to already-open previews immediately.

enumDescriptions: Offer to enable when the workspace contains .xlsx / .docx / .pptx files.
Always register the MCP server (downloading the binary on first use).
ooxmlViewer.mcpServer.enabled.description: Controls when the OOXML MCP server is registered with GitHub Copilot Chat in Agent mode through VS Code. The server lets agents read .xlsx / .docx / .pptx files and active Viewer context via dedicated tools. Claude Code and Codex require separate MCP configuration and do not receive active Viewer context.

ooxmlViewer.mcpServer.binaryPath.description: Optional absolute path to a pre-installed `ooxml-mcp-server` binary (e.g. one installed via `cargo install`). When empty, the extension downloads a prebuilt binary on demand.
